explanation: The theorem states that the element piO of v.adicCompletionIntegers K, whose valuation is exp(-1), is irreducible. Mathlib has the reverse direction (Valuation.Integers.valuation_irreducible_lt_one/_pos, v_irreducible_lt_one/_pos). It also has the DVR characterisation (irreducible_iff_uniformizer, irreducible_of_span_eq_maximalIdeal) and the uniformizer API in Valuation/Discrete/Basic.lean (IsUniformizer.not_isUnit, IsUniformizer.is_generator, generator_eq_exp_neg_one_of_mem_range). None of these directly says that an integer of valuation exp(-1) is irreducible. A derivation would chain several lemmas, including an IsRankOneDiscrete instance, identifying the generator with exp(-1), is_generator and the span-of-maximal-ideal lemma, which is more than two lines. Searched: exp (-1) throughout Mathlib, and theorem names containing irreducible or uniformizer in the DedekindDomain, Valuation, Topology/Algebra and NumberTheory directories.
